_comment: Visitor-facing words for the price file (Step 6a), read by backend/app/pricing/api.py. {as_of} is the Treasury curve's date (YYYY-MM-DD). One label per curve status: live = fetched today; cached = Treasury unreachable, last curve kept; fixture = never reached Treasury, bundled sample curve. Settings live in backend/app/config/pricing.toml; sources in docs/public-sources.md.

label.cached: Illustrative, as of {as_of}. Treasury could not be reached, so this uses the last curve LoanIQ fetched.
label.fixture: Illustrative, as of {as_of}. Treasury could not be reached, so this uses a bundled sample curve, not today's.

sources.name: U.S. Treasury, Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates
sources.used_for: The daily anchor: each product's current coupon starts from a Treasury par yield.

sources.name: LoanIQ illustrative pricing model
sources.used_for: Spreads, durations, the prepayment cap, traded bands and the pay-up S-curve. Illustrative; no public source is recorded for these numbers.
